findings.finding: Volume, depth and gross-margin figures in the FY2025 review have no explicit period; S3–S5 present them as FY2024→FY2025
findings.action: Assumption recorded in project.json (source says 'over the same period'); footnote the period basis on S3–S5

findings.finding: 'per 100 EUR' figures rely on the definition in F0018 (margin net of sales that would have happened anyway); headline must not imply absolute EUR losses
findings.action: S6 cites F0018 and wording kept as margin per hundred euros of promotion

findings.finding: The ask must be explicit: the board decides on the proposal on the table (+20% budget, deep discounts in Household), not on an abstract principle
findings.action: S1 and S8 state the decision: reject the +20% increase, hold budget, reallocate by category; S7 tests the proposal explicitly

findings.finding: Sources do not allow quantifying the EUR value of the recommended plan; the board may ask for it
findings.action: Next steps include a margin bridge and controlled promotion tests before Q1 sign-off; no unsupported estimate added

findings.finding: H6 unresolved: the gross-margin decline may be partly driven by input costs or mix; linking it fully to promotions would overclaim
findings.action: Governing thought says margin fell 'while' promotions deepened (no causal claim); caveat on S5; margin bridge as next step

findings.finding: Counterfactual: without promotions total volume might have declined; the +2.1% could still be partly promotion-driven
findings.action: Mitigated by I3 (71% of promoted volume from full-price buyers, −22% post-promotion dip); recommendation keeps promotion where incremental margin is positive rather than abolishing it

findings.finding: Positive returns in Fresh (+1.6) and Beverages (+0.8) are small; scaling them may hit diminishing returns
findings.action: S8 recommends targeted, tested promotion in these categories, not budget reallocation at scale

findings.finding: S3 and S4 could merge into one 'promotions shift demand' slide
findings.action: Kept separate: outcome (total volume) vs mechanism (loyalty-card data); why_not_merge recorded
Kept: S7 is the explicit test of the proposal under decision; 8 slides within the 9-slide limit

findings.finding: A waterfall on S3 would sum growth rates (+14%, −6%) that have different volume bases; contributions are not additive
findings.action: Changed S3 to a bar chart of growth rates (promoted, full-price, total)

findings.finding: S6 ranking includes negative and positive values
findings.action: Use a diverging horizontal bar sorted from Household to Fresh with a zero axis
